title: Native Database Backends continuity and durable reasoning ledger

records.note: Provider-neutral capability/result/planner foundation; live external dependency gates inherited where not re-executed.

records.meaning: Implementation is direct ooRexx code and may be library-independent; GeoPackage portable reader is the current exemplar.
Implementation calls a qualified native ABI through ooRexx Foreign Runtime; PostgreSQL/libpq is the current exemplar.
Implementation reaches a provider through an explicit process/bridge path; retained as fallback, never mislabeled native.

records.rule: hard capability eligibility precedes priority ranking
records.note: Priority cannot compensate for UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN/CONDITIONAL hard requirements.

records.rule: lowest numerical priority wins among eligible backends
records.note: Current profiles: PostgreSQL native 10, GeoPackage pure ooRexx 20, PostgreSQL process fallback 100.
After acquisition, failure is surfaced; no silent replay through another implementation.
Compatibility text framing is an adapter over NativeDatabaseExecution/Result.
Do not collapse provider NULL into empty string merely for compatibility framing.

records.rule: PQexecParams/PQsendQueryParams with Foreign Runtime pointer/buffer ownership; no SQL interpolation fallback
must have explicit streaming source/sink, backpressure and lifetime ownership before capability becomes SUPPORTED
accelerator supplements, never replaces, the dependency-free reference/correctness route

records.rule: NoSQLServer remains external package reference; shim owns wire/session compatibility only
